query: inference request body size limit 10 MB

text: No. The Moss Inference request body limit is 4 MB, not 10 MB (same for moss/fastlane-1 and vendor models; limits apply per project). A body over 4 MB is rejected with HTTP 413 (invalid_request_error). Do not retry unchanged: fix it by sending a smaller body. (Source: docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/errors-and-limits)
